n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (The gate should have collapsed inward. Instead, it tears sideways across the street, peeling brick from the buildings like bark.)

n2.speaker: player
n2.text: (Your new mana is barely enough to keep your hands from shaking. Somewhere beyond the dust, steel rings once. Then again.)

n4.speaker: player
n4.text: (A spear passes over your shoulder. The creature behind you folds around it: too many joints, a crown of black antlers, no eyes.)

n5.speaker: faelen
n5.text: If you can stand, move the civilian. If you can fight, guard my left. Decide now.

n6.speaker: player
n6.text: (You drag the fallen courier behind an overturned car, then raise the cheap blade you bought this morning.)

n7.speaker: player
n7.text: (The elf fights like a door barred against a storm. Every step costs her blood. Every step holds.)

n8.speaker: faelen
n8.text: When it lunges, cut beneath the jaw. Do not chase the wound.

n9.speaker: player
n9.text: (It lunges. You cut. Her spear drives through the opening, and the creature comes apart in a rain of ash.)

n10.speaker: faelen
n10.text: Black antlers... It crossed after me.

n12.speaker: faelen
n12.text: I know it is dead. That is enough for tonight.

n13.speaker: player
n13.text: (She turns toward the ruined gate. Two steps later, one knee strikes the pavement.)

n15.speaker: player
n15.text: "Then bleed on your own after we get indoors. My building is across the street."

n17.speaker: player
n17.text: (She collapses before she can take a third step. You catch her. Her hand stays locked around the spear.)

n18.speaker: faelen
n18.text: One night. At dawn, I leave.

n19.speaker: player
n19.text: (Dawn finds her asleep in the chair beside the front door, boots on, spear within reach. She does not leave.)
